# docker_task (Data Source)

Looks up one swarm task (`GET /tasks/{id}`) by `id`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. `inspect` holds the whole Engine task object (status, container status, network attachments); only the container environment inside it is sensitive. List tasks with `docker_tasks`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_tasks" "web" {
  service_id    = "web"
  desired_state = "running"
}

data "docker_task" "first" {
  id = data.docker_tasks.web.ids[0]
}

output "first_task" {
  value = {
    name      = data.docker_task.first.name
    node_id   = data.docker_task.first.node_id
    container = data.docker_task.first.container_id
    state     = data.docker_task.first.inspect.status.state
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Task ID.

### Read-Only

- `container_id` (String) ID of the task's container (`Status.ContainerStatus.ContainerID`); empty before it starts.
- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of inspect_json; changes whenever the object changes.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon the provider talked to (GET /version Version).
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version the provider negotiated with the daemon (GET /version ApiVersion, capped by the client's max).
- `inspect` (Attributes) The task inspect response as a nested object mirroring Task field by field (snake_case). Only ContainerSpec.Env and volume driver options are sensitive (field-level); the rest, including Args/Command, stays plain in plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inspect))
- `inspect_json` (String, Sensitive) The exact Engine API inspect response for the task, as JSON. Only ContainerSpec.Env and volume driver options are sensitive (field-level); the rest, including Args/Command, stays plain in plans.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels on the task (`Labels`).
- `name` (String) Task name as the CLI shows it: `<service>.<slot>`, or `<service>.<node ID>` for global services.
- `node_id` (String) ID of the node the task is assigned to (`NodeID`); empty while unassigned.
- `service_id` (String) ID of the task's service (`ServiceID`).
- `slot` (Number) Slot of a replicated service's task (`Slot`); 0 for global services.
- `version_index` (Number) The task object's `Version.Index`; it changes on every update.
